_comment: Per-fixture suppressions for the upstream-parity check.
Each entry suppresses specific divergence kinds on a single fixture file.
entries[].file    path relative to the repo root (e.g. 'fixtures/upstream/zizmor/tests/.../foo.yml')
'extra:<rule-id>'      karinto fires <rule-id> but upstream doesn't; suppress.
'upstream-only'    upstream fires; karinto silent. Suppress (e.g. shellcheck-only finding).
'ignore'           suppress any divergence on this file.
'fires:<rule-id>'  require karinto to fire <rule-id> on this fixture even though
no actionlint kind maps to it (e.g. zizmor template-injection
Info backstop on actionlint OK testdata). Fails hard if <rule-id>
stops firing — keeps regression detection on cross-source rules.
Always include a 'reason' field so future readers can see why it's here.
